name: p6xer-cpm-mcp
display_name: P6XER CPM — Primavera P6 Schedule Analyzer & CPM Engine
description: Parse, analyze, quality-check, edit, and recalculate Primavera P6 XER schedule files with a deterministic CPM engine and MCP tools.

tools.name: parse_xer_file
tools.description: Parse a P6 XER file and return project list, activity counts, resources, and calendars

tools.name: get_project_activities
tools.description: Get activities filtered by project, status, or task type

tools.name: get_critical_path
tools.description: Find critical path activities with zero or negative total float

tools.name: analyze_resource_utilization
tools.description: Planned/actual hours and costs per resource with over-allocation flags

tools.name: check_schedule_quality
tools.description: DCMA-style schedule quality check: missing logic, long durations, high float

tools.name: get_resources
tools.description: List all resources, optionally filtered by type

tools.name: get_resource_assignments
tools.description: Resource-activity assignments with enriched names and costs

tools.name: get_wbs
tools.description: Work Breakdown Structure hierarchy

tools.name: get_relationships
tools.description: Predecessor/successor relationships enriched with task codes

tools.name: get_calendars
tools.description: Calendar definitions with hours-per-period data

tools.name: get_schedule_summary
tools.description: At-a-glance schedule stats, date range, and critical count

tools.name: get_earned_value
tools.description: EVM metrics: PV, EV, AC, CPI, SPI, EAC per project

tools.name: get_activity_detail
tools.description: Full detail for a single activity including predecessors, successors, and resources

tools.name: export_schedule_graph
tools.description: Export schedule as nodes/edges JSON with cycle detection

tools.name: open_schedule_workspace
tools.description: Open an XER into an editable in-memory workspace for CPM operations

tools.name: apply_schedule_operations
tools.description: Apply structured changes to a workspace

tools.name: recalculate_schedule
tools.description: Run a CPM forward/backward pass on a workspace

tools.name: preview_schedule_changes
tools.description: Compare recalculated dates against the original XER

tools.name: export_schedule_xer
tools.description: Export a workspace to a P6-compatible XER file

tools.name: validate_operations
tools.description: Pre-validate structured operations before applying them

tools.name: set_activity_duration
tools.description: Set the target duration of a single activity in hours

tools.name: set_activity_duration_days
tools.description: Set the target duration of a single activity in calendar days

tools.name: add_activity_predecessor
tools.description: Add or update a predecessor relationship

tools.name: remove_activity_predecessor
tools.description: Remove a predecessor relationship

tools.name: set_activity_constraint
tools.description: Set or remove a date constraint on an activity

tools.name: set_activity_status
tools.description: Set the status of an activity

tools.name: create_activity
tools.description: Create a new activity in the schedule

tools.name: clone_workspace
tools.description: Deep-copy a workspace in memory (no disk I/O)

tools.name: delete_activity
tools.description: Delete an activity from the schedule

tools.name: rename_activity
tools.description: Rename an activity

tools.name: get_milestones
tools.description: Return all milestone tasks sorted by early start

tools.name: close_workspace
tools.description: Close a workspace and free its memory

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all open workspaces

tools.name: get_workspace_info
tools.description: Return metadata about a workspace

tools.name: get_activity_cpm_dates
tools.description: Get CPM dates (ES/EF/LS/LF/TF/FF) for a single activity

tools.name: list_activities_after_cpm
tools.description: List all activities with CPM dates, sorted and paginated

tools.name: run_cpm_diagnostics
tools.description: Run cycle, orphan, and CPM diagnostics on a workspace

tools.name: analyze_schedule_ai
tools.description: AI-powered schedule analysis via an OpenAI-compatible LLM
